internal.title: Incident Resolved: High Kafka Consumer Lag in Accounting Service
internal.body:
At 11:55 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high Kafka consumer lag in the accounting service, with a backlog of approximately 5200 records. Initial diagnosis confirmed the issue was due to a queue backlog. Secondary hypotheses around resource exhaustion were considered but not confirmed as primary causes. Error injection was ruled out due to low error rates.

The remediation involved disabling the kafkaQueueProblems flag at 12:15 UTC, which was approved and executed promptly. Post-action verification showed the consumer lag reduced to normal levels (5 records), confirming recovery.

No critical resource exhaustion or error injection was found to contribute significantly to the incident. The service is now stable and operating normally.

external.body: Between 11:55 and 12:15 UTC on 2026-11-08, the accounting service experienced delays in processing due to a backlog in message consumption. This caused temporary slowdowns in transaction processing. The issue was identified and resolved within 20 minutes, and normal service operation has resumed. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
